title: Pure Heroic
summary: Heroic Challengers and their Rank 4 Champions, with generic staples. The deck drops to 500 LP on purpose: Heroic Champion - Claivesolish pays the LP to double a monster's ATK, and several Heroic cards gain extra effects at 500 or less. Heroic Envoy and Morning Star search, and Thousand Blades summons a Heroic from the Deck, so two Level 4 Warriors and a Rank 4 come out in one turn. Heroic Champion - Magnum Excalibur, the newest card, equips itself to another monster for 2000 ATK/DEF on either Main Phase and recycles Warriors from the GY. Number 86: Heroic Champion - Rhongomyniad is Forbidden in the TCG.
